adjudication.note: Choose whether Discord-generated links should suppress the intro box via query parameter or whether the current behavior is acceptable.

question: Triaged needs-product-decision — needs a human/product call.
summary: Owner explored several approaches (navigator.cookieEnabled, JS cookie probe, UA detection) and all failed. The viable options are: (1) embed a hide_intro=1 query parameter in Discord bot links so the box never shows from bot-generated URLs, (2) accept the regression, or (3) server-side IP/fingerprint heuristics. All require an owner judgment call.
